case.title: The Safe House Mystery
case.introduction: Tonight at The Ashgrove Safe House, the swap of a famous painting with a fake one has turned the evening upside down. No one is allowed to leave. 6 guests are still here, and each one is hiding something. One of them is not who they say they are. Find that person.
case.crime: The swap of a famous painting with a fake one
case.target_fake_identity: Isabella Okafor, a doctor people trust
case.escape_plan: Isabella Okafor plans to sneak out while everyone is confused, and be gone before the police arrive.

rooms.name: The Grand Lobby
rooms.description: A huge hall with stone floors and a wide staircase.

rooms.name: The Lounge
rooms.description: Soft yellow light, leather chairs, and slow music playing.

rooms.name: The Dining Room
rooms.description: A long table, still set for dinner.

rooms.name: The Private Study
rooms.description: Book shelves, a heavy desk, and one locked drawer.

rooms.name: The Terrace Garden
rooms.description: Cool night air, tall bushes, and a view of the water.

rooms.name: The Guest Rooms
rooms.description: A hallway of numbered doors. Most are half open.

characters.name: Isabella Okafor
characters.background: A doctor with a messy past.
characters.secret: Isabella is covering for a family member.
characters.goal: Isabella wants to leave before anyone finds out the truth.
characters.alibi: Says they were in The Grand Lobby when it happened.
knowledge: Knows exactly how the crime was done.
lies: Says they never went into the room where the main clue was found.
Says all their papers are real.

timeline.description: The crime happens: the swap of a famous painting with a fake one.
The alarm goes off. No one may leave.
Isabella Okafor is seen moving toward a side door.

evidence.name: a cloth with blood on it
evidence.description: A fine cloth with two letters sewn on it and a dark stain.

evidence.name: a wine glass
evidence.description: A half-full glass. The drink smells bitter.

evidence.name: a photo
evidence.description: A photo of two guests who say they have never met.

evidence.name: a hidden key
evidence.description: A small brass key taped under a drawer.

evidence.name: muddy shoes
evidence.description: Costly shoes covered in garden mud, but it has not rained inside.

evidence.name: a fake passport
evidence.description: It looks real, but the year of birth is a little bit wrong.

evidence.name: a torn train ticket
evidence.description: A ticket ripped in two. The time on it is earlier than someone said.

evidence.name: a cheap phone
evidence.description: A cheap phone with only one number called.

hidden_clues: Isabella Okafor's story about where they were does not match the a cloth with blood on it.
Two guests say they have never met, but a photo shows they have.

solution.target_true_identity: A wanted criminal pretending to be a doctor
solution.reasoning: Isabella Okafor is the hidden person. The main clues (a cloth with blood on it, a wine glass) put them at the scene and show their story is not true. Their papers are fake too.

state.current_objective: One of the 6 guests at The Ashgrove Safe House is using a fake name. Search the rooms, talk to everyone, and find the person behind the swap of a famous painting with a fake one. Some guests lie. Check their stories carefully.

relationship_notes: The detective spoke to me harshly.
